text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 大家好,欢迎收听《Real Easy English》。
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎收聽《Real Easy English》。

text: In this podcast,
we have real conversations
zh: 我们会呈现真实的对话,
zh_hant: 我們會呈現真實的對話,

text: in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 用简单的英语帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 用簡單的英語幫助你學習。

text: I'm Beth.
And I'm Georgie.
You can find a video version of this podcast
zh: 你可以在我们的网站上找到这个播客的视频版本,
zh_hant: 你可以在我們的網站上找到這個播客的影片版本,

text: and a worksheet to help you learn all on our website,
zh: 还有帮助你学习的练习表,
zh_hant: 還有幫助你學習的練習表,

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi, Georgie.
Hello, Beth.
How is your week going?
It's going well.
It's quite a busy one, isn't it?
is.
It's only Wednesday.
Yeah.
It feels like Friday,
but today we're talking
zh: 不过今天我们要聊的话题
zh_hant: 不過今天我們要聊的話題

text: about secrets .
A secret is a piece of information
that you don't tell other people.
Beth, does that mean you're going to tell me
all of your secrets ?
zh: 你所有的秘密都告诉我?
zh_hant: 你所有的秘密都告訴我?

text: No. Not now.
Maybe later.
Oo, OK.
So, Georgie, are you good at keeping secrets ?
zh: 那么,Georgie,你擅长保守秘密吗?
zh_hant: 那麼,Georgie,你擅長保守秘密嗎?

text: No, I'm definitely not good at keeping
secrets .
I'm a bit of an open book ,
zh: 我算是个比较坦率的人,
zh_hant: 我算是個比較坦率的人,

text: which means the opposite of someone
who is good at keeping secrets .
zh: 擅长保守秘密的人相反。
zh_hant: 擅長保守秘密的人相反。

text: You're very honest and share things, maybe too much.
zh: 你很诚实,什么都愿意分享,可能有点太多了。
zh_hant: 你很誠實,什麼都願意分享,可能有點太多了。

text: What about you?
OK.
I am probably the same as you.
I think
I'm not good at keeping secrets ,
but if it's a really important secret
zh: 但如果是非常重要的秘密,
zh_hant: 但如果是非常重要的秘密,

text: and I've been told, please don't tell anyone,
zh: 而且别人叮嘱我不要告诉任何人,
zh_hant: 而且別人叮囑我不要告訴任何人,

text: then I won't tell anyone.
Yes.
So, Beth,
what is the biggest secret
zh: 你保守过的最大的秘密
zh_hant: 你保守過的最大的秘密

text: you've had to keep ?
I flew abroad
to surprise my boyfriend
at the time, his dad.
zh: 当时他还是我男朋友——去见他爸爸。
zh_hant: 當時他還是我男朋友——去見他爸爸。

text: And we had to keep it a secret .
And we even called him in the morning
zh: 我们甚至在早上给他打了
zh_hant: 我們甚至在早上給他打了

text: on a video call and pretended we were at home,
zh: 视频电话,假装我们在家,
zh_hant: 影片電話,假裝我們在家,

text: and we were actually in a different country.
zh: 实际上我们是在另一个国家。
zh_hant: 實際上我們是在另一個國家。

text: Oh my gosh.
So that was a big secret .
So it went well.
Was he surprised?
It did.
He was very surprised.
We were very pleased that we kept it a secret .
zh: 我们很高兴保住了这个秘密。
zh_hant: 我們很高興保住了這個秘密。

text: We did well.
done, well done.
I've had to keep a big secret .
zh: 我也保守过一个大秘密。
zh_hant: 我也保守過一個大秘密。

text: Last year, my friend told me
that she was going to propose to her girlfriend.
But she told me I had to keep it a secret .
And it's really, it was really difficult
because we have a group of friends,
zh: 因为我们有一群共同的朋友,
zh_hant: 因為我們有一群共同的朋友,

text: and I really wanted to tell them,
but I couldn't.
And I managed to keep it a secret , so I was very proud of myself.
zh: 我成功保守了这个秘密,所以我为自己感到骄傲。
zh_hant: 我成功保守了這個秘密,所以我為自己感到驕傲。

text: That's good.
Well done.
That reminds me, I had a big
zh: 这让我想起,我也有一个大
zh_hant: 這讓我想起,我也有一個大

text: secret , too.
My friend told me, don't tell anyone and don't tell your mum.
zh: 我朋友告诉我,别告诉任何人,也别告诉你妈妈。
zh_hant: 我朋友告訴我,別告訴任何人,也別告訴你媽媽。

text: And I told my mum by accident.
zh: 结果我不小心告诉了我妈妈。
zh_hant: 結果我不小心告訴了我媽媽。

text: Oh, no.
Can you reveal the secret to us?
zh: 你能跟我们透露一下这个秘密吗?
zh_hant: 你能跟我們透露一下這個秘密嗎?

text: Oh, yeah.
She was pregnant.
She's now had the baby.
OK.
But she said, yeah, I'm pregnant.
But it's really early, so please don't tell anyone.
zh: 但还很早,所以请别告诉任何人。
zh_hant: 但還很早,所以請別告訴任何人。

text: Don't even tell your mum.
And then I spoke to my mum a few weeks later
zh: 结果几周后我和我妈聊天时
zh_hant: 結果幾周後我和我媽聊天時

text: and said, you don't know, she's pregnant.
zh: 说,你还不知道吧,她怀孕了。
zh_hant: 說,你還不知道吧,她懷孕了。

text: And then I realised, oh, no, I wasn't supposed to tell you.
zh: 然后我才意识到,糟了,我不该说的。
zh_hant: 然後我才意識到,糟了,我不該說的。

text: But that was kind of an accident.
It was definitely an accident.
Yeah.
But I felt really bad.
Well, now she's had the baby.
zh: 不过现在她已经生了孩子。
zh_hant: 不過現在她已經生了孩子。

text: It's OK.
It's not a surprise anymore.
Sorry! Beth, do you think secrets are a good or a bad thing?
zh: 抱歉!Beth,你觉得秘密是好事还是坏事?
zh_hant: 抱歉!Beth,你覺得秘密是好事還是壞事?

text: I think it really depends
on the secret .
There are good secrets ,
like proposing or having a baby.
And then I guess a bad secret really is a lie .
zh: 而我猜坏的秘密其实就是谎言。
zh_hant: 而我猜壞的秘密其實就是謊言。

text: If you have to lie , then that's not good.
zh: 如果你不得不撒谎,那就不好了。
zh_hant: 如果你不得不撒謊,那就不好了。

text: Yeah, I agree.
It's, it's not, yeah, it's not good to lie.
And I think that's a reason why I'm not very good at keeping secrets.
zh: 我想这也是我不太擅长保守秘密的原因。
zh_hant: 我想這也是我不太擅長保守秘密的原因。

text: Because I'm a really bad liar .
You can see it in my face if I'm holding, holding in a secret.
zh: 如果我藏着秘密,从我脸上就能看出来。
zh_hant: 如果我藏著秘密,從我臉上就能看出來。

text: Yeah.
I think sometimes you can look at someone's face and know what they're thinking.
zh: 我觉得有时候你看一个人的表情就能知道他们在想什么。
zh_hant: 我覺得有時候你看一個人的表情就能知道他們在想什麼。

text: I'm definitely like that.
If I'm annoyed or angry or something,
you can tell from my face.
Well that's good because I'll always know
zh: 那挺好的,因为这样我就总能知道
zh_hant: 那挺好的,因為這樣我就總能知道

text: that you're being honest and not keeping any secrets from me.
zh: 你是诚实的,不会对我隐瞒任何秘密。
zh_hant: 你是誠實的,不會對我隱瞞任何秘密。

text: Let's recap the vocabulary we heard during the conversation.
zh: 让我们回顾一下对话中出现的词汇。
zh_hant: 讓我們回顧一下對話中出現的詞彙。

text: We had a secret ,
which is a piece of information that you can't tell
zh: 意思是你不能告诉别人的
zh_hant: 意思是你不能告訴別人的

text: other people.
And we also have the phrase keep a secret ,
zh: 我们还讲到了keep a secret(保守秘密)这个短语,
zh_hant: 我們還講到了keep a secret(保守秘密)這個短語,

text: which means to not share that piece of information.
zh: 意思是不把那条信息分享出去。
zh_hant: 意思是不把那條資訊分享出去。

text: If someone is an open book ,
zh: 如果一个人是open book(敞开的书,坦率的人),
zh_hant: 如果一個人是open book(敞開的書,坦率的人),

text: they don't have secrets and they're honest about their life.
zh: 意思是他们没有秘密,对自己的生活很坦诚。
zh_hant: 意思是他們沒有秘密,對自己的生活很坦誠。

text: And if you lie , you say something that's not true.
zh: 而如果你lie(撒谎),就是说了不真实的话。
zh_hant: 而如果你lie(撒謊),就是說了不真實的話。

text: It's usually seen as negative,
zh: 这通常被视为负面的事,
zh_hant: 這通常被視為負面的事,

text: but sometimes you have to lie if you
zh: 但有时候如果你想保守一个秘密,
zh_hant: 但有時候如果你想保守一個秘密,

text: want to keep a secret .
And we call someone who lies a lot a liar .
zh: 我们把经常撒谎的人称为liar(骗子)。
zh_hant: 我們把經常撒謊的人稱為liar(騙子)。

text: And that's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这就是本期《Real Easy English》的全部内容。
zh_hant: 這就是本期《Real Easy English》的全部內容。

text: Test what you've learned with the free worksheet
zh: 用我们网站上的免费练习表
zh_hant: 用我們網站上的免費練習表

text: on our website, bbclearningenglish.com
zh: 检验一下你学到的内容吧,网址是bbclearningenglish.com。
zh_hant: 檢驗一下你學到的內容吧,網址是bbclearningenglish.com。

text: We'll be back next week with another conversation in easy English.
zh: 我们下周将带来另一场简单英语对话,
zh_hant: 我們下週將帶來另一場簡單英語對話,

text: Goodbye.
Bye.
